summary: Golden Ventures is a Toronto-headquartered seed-stage, sector-agnostic fund that invests throughout North America. Its FAQ says it is investing from Fund V, a $100,000,000 fund, targets initial commitments of $500,000 to $2,500,000 for 8% to 15% of a company, reserves capital for follow-on, and counts pre-seed, seed and seed extensions as its core. The homepage features portfolio companies such as Float and ResQ and publishes an info email. A street address is not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: Featured on the homepage as a portfolio company (spend management for Canadian finance teams). Round and date are not stated.
